描述_EN: the marbling effect was achieved by twisting a light-coloured clay with a dark-coloured clay, and then using the twisted clays to form the jar. in the tang dynasty (618-907) daily utensils were usually made of stoneware and goods for burial were made of earthenware. this jar was probably a funerary piece, as lead-glazed vessels could poison the user.
描述_ZN: 大理石纹的效果是通过将浅色的粘土与深色的粘土缠绕在一起，然后用缠绕的粘土来形成罐子。 在唐代（618-907），日常用具通常由石器制成，而埋葬物品则由陶器制成。 这个罐子可能是一件殉葬品，因为铅釉器皿会使使用者中毒。
